items.name: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
items.description: Object IDs manipulated in request to access unauthorized data

items.name: Broken Authentication
items.description: Compromised auth tokens, missing password complexity, credential stuffing

items.name: Broken Object Property Level Authorization
items.description: Mass assignment or excessive data exposure in object properties

items.name: Unrestricted Resource Consumption
items.description: Missing rate limiting or resource consumption bounds

items.name: Broken Function Level Authorization (BFLA)
items.description: User can call administrative or higher-privileged functions

items.name: Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
items.description: Automated exploitation of business flows (scalping, scraping)

items.name: Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
items.description: API fetches remote resources from user-supplied URLs without validation

items.name: Security Misconfiguration
items.description: Verbose error messages, unnecessary HTTP methods, loose CORS

items.name: Improper Inventory Management
items.description: Deprecated or shadow API endpoints exposed to the public

items.name: Unsafe Consumption of APIs
items.description: Trusting third-party APIs without proper data sanitization
